This page brings together a selection of my public projects. They range from practical data applications to technical presentations and curated resources. The emphasis is on **open data, reproducibility and useful results**.

## Featured projects

### Wildfire monitoring in Spain

**[Visor Fuego](https://github.com/santiagomota/visor-fuego)**  
[Live application](https://santiagomota.github.io/visor-fuego/) · [Source code](https://github.com/santiagomota/visor-fuego)

An interactive viewer of wildfire risk and active fires in Spain. The map is updated **twice a day**, bringing together information useful for monitoring changing fire conditions.

**Focus:** geospatial visualization · environmental data · automated updates

### Open data resources

**[Open Data](https://github.com/santiagomota/Open_Data)**  
[Browse the website](https://santiagomota.github.io/Open_Data/) · [Alternative site](https://open-data-pages.netlify.app/) · [Kaggle notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/santiagomota/open-data-links/)

A curated collection of open-data resources, including datasets, books, blogs, links and reference material. The repository is updated periodically and is also available as a website and a Kaggle notebook.

**Focus:** open data · documentation · knowledge sharing

## Machine learning and competitions

### Taxi trip time prediction — Kaggle

**[ECML/PKDD 2015 Taxi Trip Time Prediction (II)](https://github.com/santiagomota/kaggle-taxi-II)**  
[Competition results](https://www.kaggle.com/c/pkdd-15-taxi-trip-time-prediction-ii) · [Kaggle profile](https://www.kaggle.com/santiagomota)

A competition focused on predicting taxi trip times. **10th place among 369 teams and 456 participants** in the 2015 competition.

**Focus:** predictive modelling · mobility data · machine learning

### Automated machine learning — Machine Learning Spain

**[Machine Learning Spain XXVII](https://github.com/santiagomota/Machine_Learning_Spain)**

Presentation, code and examples from a talk on **automated machine learning**, with particular attention to the H2O ecosystem.

**Focus:** AutoML · model development · technical communication
